new.exam_name: KPSC KAS (Karnataka Gazetted Probationers Group A & B Combined Competitive Examination)
new.aliases: KAS; Karnataka Administrative Service; KPSC Gazetted Probationers; Karnataka PCS
new.forms_out: As per notification (2026 cycle: notified 31 July, applications in August)
new.last_date: As per notification (2026: 31 August, reportedly extended)
new.eligibility: Bachelor's degree from a recognised university. Age 21 to 40 for general merit, 43 for categories 2A/2B/3A/3B and 45 for SC/ST/Category-1 (2026 notification as reported). Kannada is a compulsory qualifying paper (150 marks, minimum 35%) in the mains.
new.application_fee: Rs. 600/- (Rs. 300/- for categories 2A/2B/3A/3B; Rs. 50/- for ex-servicemen; no fee for SC/ST/Category-1/PwD) - as reported for the 2026 cycle
new.paper_pattern: Prelims has two objective papers of 100 questions and 200 marks each (2 hours each): Paper I General Studies (humanities side), Paper II General Studies incl. science & technology, environment and mental ability. Prelims is screening only; marks are not counted in final merit.
new.selection_process: Prelims (objective, screening) → Mains (5 descriptive papers + qualifying Kannada and English) → Personality test → Document verification
new.remarks: The 2024 cycle (384 posts) was hit by a re-exam and irregularity allegations. Posts change every notification; confirm on the official site.

applicants.note: IANS report (12 Nov 2026) of a state review meeting briefed by the KPSC Controller of Examinations: 1,47,067 applied for the 15 Nov 2026 prelims. Statewide appeared figure not found.

vacancies.note: 319 posts (117 Group A + 202 Group B) in the 31 July 2026 notification; also reported by aggregators as 297 regular + 22 Hyderabad-Karnataka. Previous cycle (2024) had 384 posts.

new.notes: The official KPSC site (kpsc.kar.nic.in) could not be fetched, so eligibility, fee and pattern come from aggregator summaries of the 31 July 2026 notification; verify. Latest cycle is 2026 (prelims held 15 Nov 2026, mains tentatively Feb 2027), not yet complete. Marking +2/-0.25 is as reported by aggregators.

new.exam_name: Kerala PSC KAS (Kerala Administrative Service Officer Junior Time Scale Trainee Examination)
new.aliases: KAS Kerala; Kerala Administrative Service; Kerala PSC KAS Officer
new.test_date: Prelims: June (2025: 14 June); Mains: October (2025: 17-18 October)
new.eligibility: Bachelor's degree (incl. professional) in any subject. Stream 1 (open direct recruitment): age 21-32; Stream 2 (serving non-gazetted state employees): 21-40; Stream 3 (gazetted officers): under 50. Age relaxation for SC/ST (5 yrs), OBC (3 yrs), differently abled and others, max 50. Prelims Paper II tests Malayalam, Tamil or Kannada proficiency; officers who did not study Malayalam at matric level must later pass a Malayalam test.
new.paper_pattern: Prelims: Paper I General Studies (100 marks, 90 min); Paper II (100 marks, 90 min) = General Studies II (50) + language proficiency in Malayalam/Tamil/Kannada (30) + English (20). Objective MCQ. Prelims is a screening test only.
new.selection_process: Prelims (objective, screening) → Mains (3 descriptive papers of 100 marks) → Interview (45 marks) → Document verification
new.remarks: Not held every year (2025 was the second KAS cycle). Only Stream 1 is open to fresh graduates; Streams 2 and 3 are for serving government employees.
new.notes: All eligibility, pattern, fee and vacancy data from the official 2025 notification. Negative marking not stated in the notification, so marking left empty. Latest cycle 2025 (interviews scheduled Jan-Feb 2026). new.exam_name: MPPSC SSE (Madhya Pradesh State Service Examination)
new.aliases: MPPSC; MP PCS; MPPSC State Service Exam; Rajya Sewa Pariksha
new.eligibility: Bachelor's degree; final-year students may apply. Age 21 to 40 for non-uniformed posts and 21 to 33 for uniformed posts (e.g. DSP) as on 1 Jan 2026; relaxations for MP domicile reserved categories. Candidates from other states can apply but are treated as unreserved; reservation only for MP domiciles.
new.application_fee: Rs. 500/- (Rs. 250/- for MP-domicile SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwD), plus portal charges
new.paper_pattern: Prelims has two objective papers, 2 hours each: Paper I General Studies (100 questions) and Paper II General Aptitude Test (100 questions, qualifying). Merit for mains is on Paper I only. Negative marking introduced from 2026.
new.selection_process: Prelims (objective) → Mains (descriptive, 1500 marks) → Interview (185 marks) → Document verification
new.remarks: Negative marking (one-third) was introduced for the first time in the 2026 prelims. Posts change every notification; confirm on the official site.

vacancies.note: 155 State Service posts in the 31 Dec 2025 notification; State Forest Service had 36 more posts through the same prelims. 2025 cycle had 158 posts.

new.notes: The official 2026 advertisement is a scanned PDF (no text), so details come from news/coaching summaries. Marks per paper reported as 300 (3 marks per question) by Drishti, while Testbook says 200 per paper - conflicting, so marks per paper omitted from paper_pattern. Marking +3/-1 from Drishti, consistent with FPJ 'one-third deducted'. new.exam_name: MPSC Rajyaseva (Maharashtra Gazetted Civil Services Combined Examination)
new.aliases: MPSC State Services; Rajyaseva; Maharashtra PCS; MPSC Gazetted Civil Services Combined Preliminary Exam
new.test_date: Prelims: May (2026: 31 May); Mains: as per notification
new.marking: -1/4 of the question's marks per wrong answer
new.eligibility: Bachelor's degree for most posts (some posts need specific degrees); final-year students may take prelims. Maximum age 38 for the open category, with relaxations for reserved categories and others. Adequate knowledge of Marathi is required; Marathi is a qualifying mains paper.
new.application_fee: Rs. 544/- (Rs. 344/- for reserved categories, EWS, orphans and PwBD) - 2026 cycle as reported
new.paper_pattern: Prelims has two objective papers: Paper I General Studies (100 questions, 200 marks) and Paper II CSAT (80 questions, 200 marks, qualifying at 33%). Prelims marks only decide mains eligibility.
new.selection_process: Prelims (objective) → Mains (9 descriptive papers, 1750 marks) → Interview (275 marks) → Document verification
new.remarks: Vacancies are often raised by corrigenda after the notification. The 2026 mains was postponed; check mpsc.gov.in.

vacancies.note: Advt 132/2025: 87 posts at notification (Free Press Journal), revised to 238 by corrigenda per PW. Previous cycle (2025) went from 385 to 605 posts.

new.notes: Official MPSC advertisement not fetched (site is script-based); details from PW and Free Press Journal. No applicant count found for the 2025 (9 Nov 2025) or 2026 (31 May 2026) prelims; 2,754 qualified for 2025 mains (Navbharat Live). Minimum age varies by post (sources give 18 or 19). Paper duration not confirmed.

new.exam_name: Manipur PSC CCE (Manipur Civil Services Combined Competitive Examination)
new.aliases: MCSCCE; Manipur PCS; Manipur Civil Service Exam; MPSC Manipur CCE
new.eligibility: Degree from a recognised university. Must be a permanent resident of Manipur (or have a parent/ancestor who was) and be able to speak Manipuri or a tribal dialect of Manipur. Age 21 to 38 (2022 cycle, as on 1 July 2022); relaxations for SC/ST (5 yrs), OBC (3 yrs), PwD (10 yrs).
new.application_fee: Rs. 600/- (Rs. 400/- for SC/ST; no fee for differently abled)
new.remarks: Held rarely: the 2022 cycle was the first in years (the 2019 exam was cancelled) and its mains ran into 2025-26. Check the official site for a new notification.

vacancies.note: Advt 01/2022 dated 07/12/2022: MCS Gr-II 17, MPS Gr-II 25, MFS Gr-III 10, Sub Deputy Collector 33, Secretariat Service Cat-VI 15.

new.notes: No CCE notification after Advt 01/2022 found. 2022 prelims held 30 April 2023; mains rescheduled to Sept 2025; mains result March 2026. Prelims pattern left empty: sources conflict (one GS paper of 300 marks vs two papers of 200 marks under the 2022 rules). No applicant/appeared figure found. One-time 3-year age relaxation applied in 2022 for the cancelled 2019 exam.

new.exam_name: Meghalaya PSC CCE (Meghalaya Civil Service Examination)
new.aliases: MCS; Meghalaya Civil Service; Meghalaya PCS; MPSC Meghalaya
new.test_date: As per notification (2025 advt prelims reported for 26 September 2026)
new.eligibility: Degree from any recognised university. Age 21 to 32 as on 1 Jan 2025; 5 years relaxation for SC/ST, more for PwD; no age bar for regular government employees who joined within age limit. Posts are reserved by Khasi-Jaintia, Garo and other categories; fee concession only for SC/ST permanent residents of Meghalaya.
new.application_fee: Rs. 460/- (half for SC/ST permanent residents of Meghalaya; PwBD exempt)
new.paper_pattern: Prelims: two compulsory objective papers of 200 marks each, 2 hours each; Paper II is qualifying (33%).
new.selection_process: Prelims (objective; 1:15 to mains) → Mains (7 descriptive papers incl. qualifying English) → Interview (150 marks)
new.remarks: Not held every year; posts depend on the advertisement. Confirm on the official site.

vacancies.note: Advt 18/2025 dated 10 Oct 2025: 36 Meghalaya Civil Service posts (UR 6, Khasi-Jaintia 14, Garo 14, OST/SC 2).

new.notes: Eligibility, fee, vacancies and pattern from official advertisement and MCS Syllabus 2025. Prelims date (26 Sep 2026) from aggregators. Negative marking not stated. No applicant figure found.

new.exam_name: Mizoram PSC CCE (Mizoram Civil Services Combined Competitive Examination)
new.aliases: MCS Mizoram; Mizoram Civil Service; Mizoram PCS; MPSC Mizoram CCE
new.eligibility: Degree from a recognised university. Must be a permanent resident of Mizoram (or have a parent/ancestor who was), have basic computer knowledge, and pass the qualifying Mizo Language Proficiency test. Age 21 to 35 as on 1 Aug 2025; relaxations for SC/ST/OBC, ex-servicemen and PwBD.
new.application_fee: As prescribed by the Commission (PwBD exempt)
new.remarks: Posts are Group A Junior Grade posts in MCS, MPS, Finance & Accounts and Information services. Not held on a fixed yearly calendar.

vacancies.note: Advertisement No.1 of 2025-26 dated 17 June 2025 (scanned official copy hosted by an aggregator): MCS 15, MPS 8, MF&AS 2, MIS 8.

new.notes: Final result of the 2025 cycle declared 9 Feb 2026 and revised 17 Feb 2026 after a non-domicile candidate was removed (Sangai Express). Prelims date and pattern not confirmed (aggregators conflict), fee amount not in the advertisement. No applicant figure found.

new.exam_name: NPSC CCE (Nagaland Civil Service, Police Service & Allied Services Examination)
new.aliases: NCS NPS & Allied Services Exam; Nagaland PCS; NPSC Combined Competitive Examination
new.eligibility: Bachelor's degree in any discipline (incl. Divinity). Age 21 to 32 as on 1 Jan 2025; 5 years relaxation for SC/ST and up to 5 years for serving government employees. Reserved posts need an Indigenous Inhabitants of Nagaland or backward-tribe certificate; others are considered only for unreserved posts.
new.paper_pattern: Prelims is one common General Studies objective paper (2025 advertisement). The pattern was revised for later cycles; check the current notification.
new.selection_process: Prelims (objective) → Mains (written) → Physical test (some posts) → Interview → Document verification
new.remarks: Covers posts from EAC and DSP down to Class-III assistant posts. Exam pattern changed from 2026; confirm on the official site.

vacancies.note: Advt NPSC/EXAM-5/2025 dated 28 Oct 2025: 96 posts across 21 items incl. 1 backlog post.

new.notes: EastMojo (22 Sep 2026) cites NPSC: in 2025-26 the 'NCS & Allied Services Examination' recorded 16,433 applications and the 'NCS & NPS & Allied Services Examination' 5,813. It is unclear which matches the 2025 exam, so applicants left null. Final results issued Aug 2026. Marks, duration and negative marking for the 2025 prelims not stated in the advertisement.

new.aliases: OCS; Odisha PCS; OAS exam; Odisha Civil Service Exam
new.test_date: Prelims: June (7 June 2026); Mains: as per notification
new.marking: -1/3 of the question's marks per wrong answer
new.eligibility: Bachelor's degree from a recognised university. Age 21 to 42 as on 1 Jan 2025; 5 years relaxation for SC/ST/SEBC/women/ex-servicemen, 10 for PwD. Must be able to read, write and speak Odia (e.g. Odia passed up to Class VII/middle school). Attempt limits apply (6 for general).
new.paper_pattern: Prelims has two objective papers of 200 marks each, 2 hours each: GS Paper I and GS Paper II (CSAT, qualifying at 33%). Prelims marks not counted for final merit.
new.selection_process: Prelims (objective) → Mains (9 descriptive papers, incl. qualifying Odia and English) → Interview (250 marks) → Document verification
new.remarks: The first notice had no OAS/OFS/ORS posts; an addendum added OAS and ORS posts. Posts change every notification.

applicants.note: PW (22 Apr 2026) citing an OPSC notice: 76,868 provisionally admitted for the OCS 2025 (Advt 05 of 2025-26) prelims held 7 June 2026. 5,690 reportedly shortlisted for mains.

vacancies.note: Advt 05 of 2025-26 (notified 31 Dec 2025): 314 posts, raised to 465 by the 1st addendum (Jan 2026). Odisha TV also reports 314 at notification.

new.notes: Official OPSC advertisement not fetched (site is script-based); details from PW and Odisha TV. Cycle is called OCS 2025 though its exams ran in 2026. Mains/final result pending as of Nov 2026.

new.exam_name: PPSC PCS (Punjab State Civil Services Combined Competitive Examination)
new.aliases: Punjab PCS; PSCSCCE; PPSC Civil Services; Punjab Civil Service Exam
new.test_date: As per notification (2025 prelims held 7 December 2025 after rescheduling)
new.eligibility: Bachelor's degree (final-year students may take prelims). Must have passed Matriculation with Punjabi as a subject or equivalent. Age 21 to 37 as on 1 Jan 2025 (21 to 28 for DSP and Deputy Superintendent Jails); relaxations up to 42 for SC/BC of Punjab and others.
new.application_fee: Rs. 1500/- (Rs. 750/- for SC/ST and BC of Punjab; Rs. 500/- for ex-servicemen, EWS, PwD, LDESM of Punjab)
new.paper_pattern: Prelims has two objective papers of 200 marks, 2 hours each: Paper I General Studies (100 questions x 2 marks) and Paper II CSAT (80 questions x 2.5 marks, qualifying at 40%). Merit on Paper I only; no negative marking.
new.selection_process: Prelims (objective) → Mains (7 descriptive papers incl. Punjabi and English) → Interview (150 marks) → Document verification
new.remarks: Matric-level Punjabi is compulsory. Posts change every notification; confirm on the official site.

vacancies.note: 322 posts in the PSCSCCE-2025 notification (copy of the official PPSC notice): PCS 46, DSP 17, Tehsildar 27, ETO 121, FCSO 13, BDPO 49, ARCS 21, LCO 3, EGSDTO 12, DSJ/DPO 13. Later PPSC notices refer to 331 posts.
